title: The Dark Truth About History of nihilism #Shorts
description:

It is primarily associated with modernity and encompasses views that reject the meaning of life, the existence of moral phenomena, the possibility of objective knowledge, and established political and social structures.

The genes do not care about History of nihilism; they care about copies. Interpreting is something we can not go without; in fact, it is a condition of subjectivity.
